articles.title: Voltara launches V2 electric scooter at Rs 89,999
articles.summary: Voltara Motors on Monday launched its V2 electric scooter priced at Rs 89,999. The company claims a range of 140 km on a single charge. Deliveries will begin in January.

articles.title: Voltara V2 scooter launched with 140 km range
articles.summary: Voltara Motors unveiled the V2 electric scooter with a claimed range of 140 km. The V2 is priced at Rs 89,999 and bookings opened on Monday.

articles.title: First look: Voltara V2 electric scooter
articles.summary: The new Voltara V2 electric scooter gets a larger battery and a claimed 140 km range. Voltara Motors says deliveries start in January and the price is Rs 89,999.

articles.title: Voltara V2 launched at 89,999 - worth it over the V1?
articles.summary: Voltara launched the V2 electric scooter today at Rs 89,999 with a claimed 140 km range. Users are debating whether it is worth upgrading from the V1.

articles.title: Government cuts electric two-wheeler subsidy to Rs 10,000
articles.summary: The government has cut the purchase subsidy for electric two-wheelers from Rs 15,000 to Rs 10,000 per vehicle. The revised subsidy applies from April 1.

articles.title: EV subsidy revised: Rs 10,000 per two-wheeler from April 1
articles.summary: Under the revised scheme the subsidy for electric two-wheelers falls from Rs 15,000 to Rs 10,000 per vehicle from April 1. Officials said the scheme budget is unchanged.

articles.title: Makers warn price rise after electric two-wheeler subsidy cut
articles.summary: Electric two-wheeler makers warned that prices could rise after the government cut the subsidy to Rs 10,000 per vehicle from Rs 15,000. The change takes effect on April 1.

articles.title: India-style EV subsidy cut: Rs 15,000 to Rs 10,000 per two-wheeler
articles.summary: Discussion of the government decision to reduce the electric two-wheeler subsidy from Rs 15,000 to Rs 10,000 per vehicle starting April 1.

articles.title: Zephyr Mobility recalls 3,200 scooters after battery fires
articles.summary: Zephyr Mobility is recalling 3,200 electric scooters after reports of battery fires. Owners will get a free battery inspection at service centres.

articles.title: Battery fire reports prompt Zephyr Mobility recall
articles.summary: Zephyr Mobility announced a recall of 3,200 electric scooters following battery fire reports. The company said the inspection is free for owners.

articles.title: Zephyr recall: 3,200 scooters, check your VIN
articles.summary: Zephyr Mobility has recalled 3,200 electric scooters over battery fire reports. Owners should check whether their scooter is included.

articles.title: Ravipur to add 500 public EV charging points by March
articles.summary: The Ravipur Municipal Corporation will install 500 public charging points for electric vehicles by March. Most chargers will be at metro stations and markets.

articles.title: 500 new charging points planned across Ravipur
articles.summary: Ravipur Municipal Corporation approved a plan for 500 public charging points by March. The chargers will be placed at metro stations, markets and parking lots.

articles.title: Ravipur plans 500 public chargers for electric vehicles
articles.summary: Ravipur Municipal Corporation plans 500 public charging points by March, mostly near metro stations.

articles.title: Electric two-wheeler sales jump 32% in October
articles.summary: Sales of electric two-wheelers rose 32% year on year in October to 1.1 lakh units, according to industry data.

articles.title: October sales: electric two-wheelers cross 1.1 lakh units
articles.summary: Electric two-wheeler sales reached 1.1 lakh units in October, up 32% year on year. Festive demand drove the growth.

articles.title: Festive season lifts electric two-wheeler sales 32%
articles.summary: Festive demand lifted electric two-wheeler sales 32% year on year in October to 1.1 lakh units.

articles.title: ChargeGrid raises $40 million in Series B led by Northstar Ventures
articles.summary: Charging startup ChargeGrid raised $40 million in a Series B round led by Northstar Ventures. It plans to expand battery swapping stations.

articles.title: ChargeGrid (battery swapping) raises $40M Series B
articles.summary: ChargeGrid, a battery swapping startup, raised $40 million in Series B funding led by Northstar Ventures.

articles.title: Opinion: are electric scooters ready for the monsoon?
articles.summary: A columnist argues that waterproofing standards for electric scooters need to be tightened before the next monsoon.

articles.title: Rumour: Voltara working on an electric motorcycle
articles.summary: A user claims that Voltara Motors is testing an electric motorcycle prototype near its factory. No official confirmation.

articles.title: Lithium carbonate prices fall 8% this quarter
articles.summary: Lithium carbonate prices fell 8% this quarter, which may lower battery pack costs for electric vehicle makers.
